messages:
taylor: Pushed a new prototype for the traffic tile: stacked mini-violin (density) + axis on top, legend on the right. Mock: https://redwood.design/protos/stacked-violin maria: Nice. two quick asks: 1) make unit switching explicit in the legend (ms / s) and clarify whether tooltips follow the same unit, 2) label when violin is smoothed vs raw jon: Smoothing concern: current default (heavy) erases short p99 spikes. Suggest presets none / light / medium with light as default. Also prefer clipping approach: clip violin to 99.5% and show clipped points as outlined dots kim: A11y: contrast between violin fills and outline dots is low for protanopia. Use colorblind-friendly palette and add keyboard focus on individual outlier dots. Screen-reader text should summarize key stats not just say "chart" alex: Copy suggestions: legend helper text = "Units for axis & tooltips". Axis suffix should include clipping note when active, e.g., "Latency (ms) — clipped to 99.5%". Tooltip should show raw value and density% and indicate if value was clipped taylor: Plan: add units dropdown in legend, smoothing presets, clip violin at 99.5% and render outliers as interactive points with larger hit targets. Add clipping badge on axis and info tooltip. Default smoothing -> light. Will update colors to palette-v3 maria: Also add storybook stories for: raw/no smoothing, light, medium + one with heavy smoothing to show why it's not default. Add a test that toggles units to seconds and checks tick formatting (2 decimals for subsecond) jon: If we clip, make sure hover on an outlier shows original un-clipped value and a link to traces. Otherwise SREs will be confused kim: Proposed SR aria-label: "Latency distribution for route /api/predict: median 44 ms, p95 127 ms. 2 values above 1s shown as outliers." Also add aria-describedby linking to the clipping info button design-bot: Tasks created D-1214: legend units dropdown, smoothing presets, clipping badge + outlier interactions, color palette update, SR text + keyboard focus rules taylor: snippet for focus + aria I'll include: ```
1s\" tabindex=\"0\">...svg...
.css .outlier:focus { outline: 3px solid var(--focus); } ``` alex: tiny phrasing nit: helper text = "Toggle units used by axis and tooltips" (slightly clearer) maria: I'll land storybook fixtures + axe run in CI and add an integration test that flips smoothing and unit toggles. Want to catch visual regressions for palette changes jon: :thumbsup:
